fields.name: restUri
fields.label: Polaris Iceberg REST URI
fields.help: Base URI of the Polaris Iceberg REST catalog API that Trino's iceberg connector (iceberg.catalog.type=rest) and dbt target. For a MANAGED context KDPS derives it from the POLARIS_SERVER host, polaris_ssl_enabled and quarkus.http(.ssl)-port; for an EXTERNAL/CDP/REMOTE context, provide it here.

fields.name: managementUri
fields.label: Polaris management API URI
fields.help: Polaris management API (principals, catalogs, grants). Used by KDPS to provision / verify the service principal a deployed Trino or dbt authenticates with.

fields.name: realm
fields.label: Polaris realm
fields.help: Realm the catalog lives in (polaris.realm-context.realms). Sent as the realm header when the server requires it.

fields.name: realmHeaderRequired
fields.label: Realm header required
fields.help: polaris.realm-context.require-header. Trino's iceberg REST client cannot send a custom realm header, so a single-realm Polaris used by Trino must resolve the default realm (require-header=false).

fields.name: catalog
fields.label: Iceberg catalog (warehouse) name
fields.help: The Polaris catalog Trino/dbt should use as its warehouse (iceberg.rest-catalog.warehouse). ODP bootstraps an Ozone-backed catalog (polaris_ozone_catalog_name).

fields.name: authType
fields.label: Polaris authentication type
fields.help: polaris.authentication.type. 'internal' = Polaris token broker (OAuth2 client-credentials with a principal's client id/secret); 'oidc' = tokens from the external IdP.
